description:
FOUND s492 (Fable, 2026-09-20) by the modules-work battery (#1994, mw-22).  Probes: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s492/probes/bigfloat1.pl (crash), bigint1.pl + bigint2.pl (identical to perl).  [[project_math_bigint_shim]] says how Math::BigInt is provided (shim vs the real module + Math::BigInt::Calc): find which BigFloat path recurses -- first measurement: `Math::BigFloat->new("1.5") + 1`, `->bmul(2)`, `->bdiv(3)` without a precision, `->bsqrt`, `->bstr`, `->numify`, `bround/bfround`; the smallest one that recurses names the function.  A binding-stack exhaustion usually means a `local`-binding recursion (upgrade/downgrade ping-pong between BigInt and BigFloat, or an overloaded op calling itself through `fallback`) -- print the first 40 frames with PCL's backtrace env if there is one.  Also: a runaway recursion must end as a perl-level die the program can trap ("Deep recursion"-free; at least not a raw SBCL abort) -- check what the control-stack guard does today and FILE it separately if it is a general hole.  Low-to-medium frequency (money/precision scripts use BigFloat).  BAR: per the layer found; `lib/` or `cl/` => full sweep + the CPAN board's Math-BigInt rows.


=== DONE (s501b) ===
The smallest recursing call: any Math::BigFloat op reaching `UNIVERSAL::isa` -- PCL's UNIVERSAL::isa DELEGATED to the class's own `isa` method, and Math::BigFloat's `sub isa` calls `UNIVERSAL::isa(@_)`: infinite recursion, "Binding stack exhausted".  Fix (runtime): `%p-isa-mro` is UNIVERSAL::isa's own answer (linearized @ISA, never an override) and is what the function spelling, `->isa` resolving to UNIVERSAL, every dispatch fallback and the XS bridge use; only the infix `isa` operator (perl's sv_isa_sv) and `->DOES` (sv_does_sv) delegate, to the own-or-INHERITED override (`%p-isa-override` = `%pcl-find-method-in-chain … "PL-ISA"`).  Second fault on the same path: `$mant->length()` received `$_` -- a WORD after `->` is a METHOD name, and PExpr handle_subcalls no longer applies split's rewrite, the `$_` default or the named-unary comma collapse to it (Math::BigInt::length carped "Rounding is not supported").
Acceptance: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s492/probes/bigfloat1.pl == perl; review r501b-bigfloat 20/20 == perl; everyday modules/Math-BigInt-BigFloat left the baseline.  CPAN board Math-BigInt-2.005003 (--no-dist-lib, a0899ba6 vs tree): 24 PASS/1 PARTIAL/29 FAIL -> 22/9/23 of 54, TOTAL passing 1506 -> 1742, 8 FIXED file rows, 0 LOST; the 1771 new failing rows are all in ten files that produced fewer rows on the base (they died in this recursion) -- one cause filed, #2560 (`Math::BigRat->new("49/4")` is 1).
Guards: Pl/t/universal-01.t 6-7, Pl/t/method-name-word-01.t 17 (fail on the a0899ba6 code).  ir-spec §7.3 (normative).
The task's second question, measured: a runaway perl recursion ends as a raw SBCL "Binding stack exhausted" abort with a Lisp backtrace (perl: runs until "Out of memory!", not trappable either) -- FILED #2556, not fixed here.
